title: Regional Bank Run
description: Illustrative SVB-style deposit run spreading across regional banks. Calibrated against the verified SVB 2023 window (JPM −9%, VNQ −6%, GLD +9%, BTC +26%); BTC's response is the least reliable part.
transmission: Unrealised bond losses trigger deposit flight
Several regional banks fail or are rescued
Banks and real estate fall; Treasuries and gold rally
